provenance.post_title: Starfinder Society: Beyond the Blood Door
provenance.asset_description: Starfinder Society Season 2 Half Pager Beyond the Blood Door, artist Julio Reyna: A roiling sphere of magical energy hovers over the streets of Absalom Station, spawning dangerous, dog-like monsters formed of bone and blood. Venture-captains Arvin and Naiaj stand ready to face this onslaught. Arvin, a male lashunta with a green mohawk, casts out his hands, sending a blast of holy magic at the creatures. Naiaj, a female bleachling gnome, fires a zero cannon at them, which shoots a line of ice. They look stern and heroic while battling to save the citizens of Absalom Station from dangerous bloodspawned beasts.
